# This file is automatically generated from cmake.toml - DO NOT EDIT
# See https://github.com/build-cpp/cmkr for more information

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)

# Regenerate CMakeLists.txt automatically when cmake.toml changes
include(cmake/cmkr.cmake OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
if(CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
    cmkr()
endif()

project(SocketSL
    VERSION 0.1.0
    LANGUAGES CXX
)

# Sub-project options
set(FLATBUFFERS_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FLATBUFFERS_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FLATBUFFERS_BUILD_FLATC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPDLOG_BUILD_EXAMPLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

# Only fetch the Boost libraries we use
set(BOOST_INCLUDE_LIBRARIES system asio endian CACHE STRING "" FORCE)

# Disable LibreSSL extras
set(LIBRESSL_APPS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBRESSL_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBRESSL_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

# All dependencies via FetchContent
include(FetchContent)

FetchContent_Declare(
    spdlog
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/gabime/spdlog.git
    GIT_TAG v1.15.3
)

FetchContent_Declare(
    flatbuffers
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/google/flatbuffers.git
    GIT_TAG v24.12.23
)

FetchContent_Declare(
    Boost
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/boostorg/boost.git
    GIT_TAG boost-1.88.0
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

FetchContent_Declare(
    libressl
    URL https://github.com/libressl/portable/releases/download/v4.0.0/libressl-4.0.0.tar.gz
)

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(spdlog flatbuffers Boost libressl)

# Shared static library
add_library(socketsl STATIC)

target_sources(socketsl PRIVATE
    shared/network/socket.cpp
    shared/network/ssl.cpp
    shared/message/message.cpp
    shared/connection/session.cpp
    shared/connection/session_manager.cpp
)

target_include_directories(socketsl PUBLIC
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shared"
)

target_compile_features(socketsl PUBLIC cxx_std_20)

target_link_libraries(socketsl PUBLIC
    spdlog::spdlog
    flatbuffers
    Boost::system
    Boost::asio
    Boost::endian
    ssl
    crypto
)

# FlatBuffers code generation
set(FBS_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/schema")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${FBS_GENERATED_DIR}")

set(FBS_FILES
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shared/message/message.fbs"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shared/request/request.fbs"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shared/response/response.fbs"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/peer/src/peer.fbs"
)

set(FBS_GENERATED_HEADERS)
foreach(FBS_FILE ${FBS_FILES})
    get_filename_component(FBS_NAME "${FBS_FILE}" NAME_WE)
    set(FBS_OUTPUT "${FBS_GENERATED_DIR}/${FBS_NAME}_generated.h")
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${FBS_OUTPUT}"
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:flatc> --cpp -o "${FBS_GENERATED_DIR}" "${FBS_FILE}"
        DEPENDS flatc "${FBS_FILE}"
        COMMENT "Generating ${FBS_NAME}_generated.h"
    )
    list(APPEND FBS_GENERATED_HEADERS "${FBS_OUTPUT}")
endforeach()

add_custom_target(generate_flatbuffers DEPENDS ${FBS_GENERATED_HEADERS})

target_sources(socketsl PRIVATE ${FBS_GENERATED_HEADERS})
target_include_directories(socketsl PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
add_dependencies(socketsl generate_flatbuffers)

# Threading
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(socketsl PUBLIC Threads::Threads)

# Platform-specific linking
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(socketsl PUBLIC crypt32)
endif()

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(socketsl PUBLIC /utf-8 /Zc:preprocessor)
endif()

if(WIN32)
    target_compile_definitions(socketsl PUBLIC _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00)
endif()

# Server executable
add_executable(server)

target_sources(server PRIVATE
    server/src/main.cpp
    server/src/connection/client_connection.cpp
)

target_include_directories(server PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/server/src"
)

target_link_libraries(server PRIVATE socketsl)

# Client executable
add_executable(client)

target_sources(client PRIVATE
    client/src/main.cpp
)

target_include_directories(client PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/client/src"
)

target_link_libraries(client PRIVATE socketsl)

# Peer executable
add_executable(peer)

target_sources(peer PRIVATE
    peer/src/main.cpp
)

target_include_directories(peer PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/peer/src"
)

target_link_libraries(peer PRIVATE socketsl)
